candidate_grammar.boundary: Finite tuples whose dynamics is exactly componentwise Fold on generated rational parts.
candidate_grammar.generator: Exhaust state domain, component rule, denominator custody, support, recurrence, period, generality and extra-dynamics choices.

excluded_inputs: semantic numerical zero is not an admitted value
negative magnitude is represented only by held orientation
irrational, imaginary and floating proof values are excluded
a completed infinity and an ungenerated continuum are excluded
intended_certificate: Independent regeneration of the complete candidate product, sole all-preserving survivor, closure properties, operational witnesses and controls.
statement: Every supplied positive finite tuple of reduced rational Fold states has a finite exact joint support; after its transient binary depths, the componentwise Fold configuration recurs with period equal to the least common multiple of the odd-core component periods.
title: Exact recurrence of every finite componentwise Fold configuration
